correctness.rationale: For p≥2, n≥6p−3, used exact published shellability K≃∨^β S^{n−4} and published cyclic homology character as stated premises, not new proof. Reconstructed Alexander dual L={vertex sets with every induced triple connected}, equivalently each chosen vertex has at most one chosen nonneighbor; L is connected with H¹(L;Q) of rank β. Under a reflection, geometric fixed points correspond to stable admissible orbit unions. Cross-orbit distance inequalities confine all nontrivial simplices to two axis blocks, each conical, with a bridge only for n even vertex-axis reflections. The component counts are m−2p+2 for odd n, m−2p for even vertex axes, m−2p+2 for even edge axes. Lefschetz gives tr(H¹L)=1−components and equivariant Alexander duality supplies sign of the reflection permutation, yielding exactly the three displayed H_{n−4} trace formulas and D_n-invariant dimensions. Independently enumerated admissible orbit unions for 54 (n,p,axis) cases, checked exact counts and cone/bridge structure, and independently enumerated original ordinary cut complexes and signed chain traces for 12 small cases; all checked traces agree with the formula. The all-p,n statement rests on the proved distance confinement, not finite enumeration.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the new reflection character and geometric component classification extending the published C_n character for exactly the same powered-cycle ordinary three-cut family. The original Chauhan–Shukla shellability result proves nonequivariant rank β, not the reflection action; the fully read published Resultary cyclic work expressly omits reflections. Bayer et al. treat unpowered cycle equivariance and other graph families, not this entire powered family. Only the new reflection terms and their D_n consequences are claimed.
residual_risks: Bayer et al. full primary papers were available only as abstract/publisher descriptions here; their less prominent appendices could contain unindexed powered-cycle extensions, despite the stated focus on unpowered cycles.
Some independent finite checks are for 54 dual orbit cases and 12 direct cut cases; the infinite result relies on the distance confinement lemma and sourced shellability theorem.
Integral D_n-lattice structure, ambient equivariant homotopy, and fixed loci of original K are not claimed.

value.rationale: The missing half of the dihedral character of the natural C_n^p ordinary three-cut family is a substantive representation-theoretic invariant. A geometric fixed-point decomposition of its Alexander dual gives an all-parameter, axis-sensitive trace formula and explicit D_n-invariant subspace dimension; it complements a known cyclic character with reusable structural information, not a numerical recomputation.

limitations: Only ordinary Δ3(C_n^p) with integer p≥2 and n≥6p−3, rational D_n action.
Fixed-locus topology calculated for Alexander dual, not for original cut complex.
